description: If \(d>0\), \(x=dq+r\), and \(r<d\), then \(q=q(x,d)\) and \(r=r(x,d)\) for the specified quotient and remainder functions.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.division_unique (x d q r : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (heq : x = d * q + r)
  (hr : r < d) :
  q = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.quotient x d ∧
    r = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.remainder x d
